summary.text: Nifty 50 rose 0.34% to 23,140.50. Its five-session change was -0.88%. One session alone does not establish a change in trend.
summary.title: A positive day within a weaker five-session period

summary.text: In the NSE EQ universe, more securities advanced than declined: 1,359 advances and 1,261 declines. The separate adjusted 52-week measure recorded 63 new highs and 83 new lows. Daily participation was stronger than this longer-horizon measure; the two describe different aspects of the market.
summary.title: Look beneath the headline index

summary.text: Among configured sectors, Nifty Consumer Durables had the strongest daily change (+0.95%); Nifty Healthcare Index had the weakest (-0.47%). Their five-session changes were +1.14% and +0.39%, respectively. This comparison shows relative performance, not an investment ranking.
